name: Olive Chicken with Red Onion, Bell Pepper & Artichoke Medley
instructions: Peel and medium dice onions. Peel and thinly slice garlic. Transfer both to a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, seed, and medium dice bell peppers; add to the bowl with the onions and garlic.
Drain artichokes and add to the bowl.
Wash, dry, and juice lemon into the bowl. Add oil and spices, then toss to combine.
Transfer veggies to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in a single layer. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
Mince olives and place in the reserved bowl; add oil and stir to combine the olive mixture.
Season both sides of the chicken with salt and pepper; nestle chicken in the veggies on the baking sheet. Spoon olive mixture over the chicken.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast until chicken is cooked through and veggies are tender, about 20 minutes.
To serve, divide roasted veggies and chicken between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
